name: dod-guard
description: Anti-cheat Definition of Done verification with locked proofs. Ships 12 skills: /interview, /ratchet, /clean-house, /step-by-step, /cheap-step, /adversarial-workflow (4-phase adversarial choreography with gated review), /test-integrity-checker (audit tests for LLM patterns where tests bless bugs instead of catching them), /blind-rewrite (delete then rebuild an implementation from a contract an agent receives without seeing the original), /tighten (autonomous loop against accidental complexity, one target per invocation, gated on both difference and reduction), /doc-reconcile (find documents that contradict each other, date each claim from its real edit history, and delete the older side when the dating is decisive), /skill-debug (debug a skill from the sessions that ran it, aligning a compacted trace of what the agent did against what the SKILL.md told it to do), and /skill-migrate (migrate a skill to work on post-4.6 models by analyzing inference gaps, benchmarking with sandbox fixtures, and gating on 4.6 compatibility).
